name: System Dashboard
description: Identity-aware staging dashboard with live admin metrics, served by a DBBASIC object. 0.6.0 adds the scheduler board (/scheduler): a Flower-style admin page over the daemon's scheduled tasks -- task table with Run now / Pause controls (mutates the scheduler trigger's state, which the daemon reads) joined with scheduler_runs, the append-only per-execution history (result JSON, error + type, duration) that object_daemon.process_scheduler records best-effort. Ships the one `urgent` attention provider on this server: scheduler runs that failed in the last 24 hours. Every other queue is work waiting for a person; this one is the machine reporting that it stopped doing its own, and a failed nightly pass is invisible by construction -- an aging run that did not happen looks exactly like a night with no overdue invoices.
